name: End-of-day report filed
description: When a closer files their day: the summary (every call and what happened on it) to the team's channel, a ✅ on their reminder. Add a webhook step to send the report anywhere else. Filing the same day again edits the summary and the reply in place (D76).

nodes.template: 📝 *{{user.name}}* filed {{event.day_label}}: {{event.totals_line}}.{{event.calls | each:"\n• {{item.contact}}: {{item.outcome_label | default:no answer}}{{item.cash | nonzero | then:\" · $\"}}{{item.cash | nonzero | money:0 | suffix:\" collected\"}}{{item.revenue | nonzero | then:\" · $\"}}{{item.revenue | nonzero | money:0 | suffix:\" revenue\"}}{{item.next_date | then:\" · next \"}}{{item.next_date | date:\"ccc LLL d\"}}{{item.dq_reason | then:\" · \"}}{{item.dq_reason}}{{item.lost_reason | then:\" · \"}}{{item.lost_reason}}" | join:""}}{{event.day_answers_lines | line}}
nodes.title: Post what happened on each call
